scripts.dev:api: npm run kill:api && cd api && ..\venv\Scripts\uvicorn portfolio_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8020
scripts.dev:web: npm run kill:web && cd web && npm run dev
scripts.dev: npm run kill:dev && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api:only" "npm run dev:web:only"
scripts.dev:full: npm run kill:dev && npm run clean:web && npm run doctor -- --fix && concurrently -n api,web,doc -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run dev:api:only" "npm run dev:web:only" "node scripts/post-dev-doctor.mjs"
scripts.dev:with-doctor: npm run doctor && npm run dev
scripts.workflow:minimal: npm run kill:dev && npm run doctor -- --fix && npm run dev
